lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, positioned posterior to the gill slits and extending along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible above the pectoral fin, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense distribution of smaller, lower-intensity spots is visible across the surface of the primary pectoral fin.
